nodes.name: Proposition 6.2: Nilsequence input
Proposition 4.5: Inverse for $\Lambda'$
nodes.statement:
For every $C_1>0$ there exists $C_2=C_2(C_1,P)>0$ such that the following holds. Let $\delta\in(0, 1/10)$, let $V\leq W^{C_1}$ be a nonnegative integer power of $W$, and let $r\in[V]$. Let $\widetilde{f_1},\widetilde{f_2}: {\mathbb Z}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$ be $1$-bounded functions supported on $[N/V]^2$, for some integer $N\geq C_2 V^{C_2}\exp(\log(1/\delta)^{C_2})$, and let $a: {\mathbb Z} \to \mathbb{R}/\mathbb{Z}$ be any function.  If
$$|\Lambda'(a,\widetilde{f_1}, \widetilde{f_2})| \geq \delta (N/V)^{2},$$
then 
there exist a positive integer power $V' = V^{O_{C_1, P}(1)}$, an integer $$\exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_{C_1, P}(1)}))N\leq N'\leq N,$$ and phases $\alpha_{0}, \ldots, \alpha_{V'-1}\in {\mathbb R}/{\mathbb Z}$
such that
\begin{multline*}
    \sum_{j\in[V']}\sum_{i\in [N/N']}\sum_y\left|\sum_{x\in [N'/(VV')]} \mathbb{E}_{z \in [(N/W_d)^{1/d}V^{-1}]} e(\alpha_{y\!\!\!\!\pmod{V'}} x)\right.\\ 
     \widetilde{f_1}(V'x + j + \frac{N'}{V}i+\widetilde P_{[r, V]}(z),y)
     \left. \widetilde{f_2}(V'x + j + \frac{N'}{V}i,y+\widetilde P_{[r, V]}(z))\vphantom{\sum_x} \right|\\
     \geq \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_{C_1, P}(1)})(N/V)^2.
\end{multline*}

nodes.name: Proposition 4.3: Degree-lowering for $\Lambda^W$
nodes.statement:
Let $k,\ell \in \mathbb{N}$ with $\max(k,\ell) \geq 2$. For every $C_1>0$ there exists $C_2 = C_2(C_1, P, k, \ell)>0$ such that the following holds. Let $V \leq W^{C_1}$ be a nonnegative integer power of $W$, and suppose that for all $\delta\in(0, 1/10)$, all positive integers $N \geq C_2 W^{C_2}\exp(\log(1/\delta)^{C_2})$, and all $1$-bounded functions $f_0, f_1, f_2: {\mathbb Z}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$ supported on $[N]^2$, the lower bound
$$|\Lambda^W(f_0, f_1, f_2)| \ge \delta N^2$$
implies that
$$\|f_0\|_{({\mathbf{e}}_1V \cdot [\pm N/V])^k,\; ({\mathbf{e}}_2 V \cdot [\pm N/V])^\ell}^{2^{k+\ell}} \geq \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{C_1}) N^2.$$
Then 
there exists some positive integer power $\tilde{V} = V^{O_{C_1,P,k,\ell}(1)}$ such that
$$\|f_0\|_{({\mathbf{e}}_1\tilde{V} \cdot [N/\tilde{V}])^{k - 1},\; ({\mathbf{e}}_2 \tilde{V} \cdot [\pm N/\tilde{V}])^\ell}^{2^{k+\ell-1}} \ge \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_{C_1,P,k,\ell}(1)})N^2$$
if $k \ge 2$ and
$$\|f_0\|_{({\mathbf{e}}_1\tilde{V} \cdot [N/\tilde{V}])^{k},\; ({\mathbf{e}}_2 \tilde{V} \cdot [\pm N/\tilde{V}])^{\ell - 1}}^{2^{k+\ell-1}} \ge \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_{C_1,P,k,\ell}(1)})N^2$$
if $\ell \ge 2$.

nodes.name: Proposition 4.2: PET quantitative concatenation
nodes.statement:
There exist a constant $C=C_d>0$ and a positive integer $t = O_d(1)$ such that for all $\delta\in(0, 1/10)$ and $1$-bounded functions $f_0,f_1,f_2: {\mathbb Z}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$ supported on $[N]^2$ {for some integer $N\geq C W_d\delta^{-C}$,} the bound
    $$|\Lambda^W(f_0,f_1,f_2)| \geq \delta N^{2}$$
implies that
\begin{align*}
&\|f_0\|_{({\mathbf{e}}_1 W_d\cdot [\pm N/W_d])^t,\; ({\mathbf{e}}_2 W_d\cdot [\pm N/W_d])^t}^{2^{2t}} \gg_d \delta^{O_d(1)} N^2\\
&\|f_1\|_{({\mathbf{e}}_1 W_d\cdot [\pm N/W_d])^t,\; (({\mathbf{e}}_2-{\mathbf{e}}_1) W_d\cdot [\pm N/W_d])^t}^{2^{2t}} \gg_d \delta^{O_d(1)} N^2\\
\quad \text{and} \quad &\|f_2\|_{({\mathbf{e}}_2 W_d\cdot [\pm N/W_d])^t,\; (({\mathbf{e}}_2-{\mathbf{e}}_1) W_d\cdot [\pm N/W_d])^t}^{2^{2t}} \gg_d \delta^{O_d(1)} N^2.
\end{align*}

nodes.name: Theorem 4.1: Inverse for $\Lambda^W$
nodes.statement:
There is a constant $C=C_P>0$ such that the following holds.  Let $\delta\in(0, 1/10)$, and let $f_0, f_1, f_2: {\mathbb Z}^2 \to \mathbb{C}$ be $1$-bounded functions supported on $[N]^2$ for some integer $N  \geq C W^{C}\exp(\log(1/\delta)^{C})$.  If
$$|\Lambda^W(f_0,f_1,f_2)| \geq \delta N^2,$$
then 
there exists some positive integer power $V = W^{O_P(1)}$ such that
\begin{align*}
    &\|f_0\|_{{\mathbf{e}}_1V \cdot [N/V],\; {\mathbf{e}}_2V \cdot [N/V]}^4 \geq \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_P(1)}) N^2,\\ 
    
    &\|f_1\|_{{\mathbf{e}}_1V \cdot [N/V],\; ({\mathbf{e}}_2-{\mathbf{e}}_1)V \cdot [N/V]}^4 \geq \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_P(1)}) N^2,\\
    \quad \text{and} \quad &\|f_2\|_{{\mathbf{e}}_2V \cdot [N/V],\; ({\mathbf{e}}_2-{\mathbf{e}}_1)V \cdot [N/V]}^4 \geq \exp(-\log(1/\delta)^{O_P(1)}) N^2.
\end{align*}

Proposition F.2: Supersaturation for corners
nodes.statement: There exists a constant $c'>0$ such that the following holds: If $A \subseteq [N]^2$ has size $\delta N^2$ for some $\delta\in(0, 1/10)$ and $N \geq \exp \exp (\delta^{-c'})$, then $A$ contains at least $(\exp(- \exp (\delta^{-c'})))N^3$ nontrivial corners.

nodes.name: Theorem 1.1: Bound for polynomial corners
nodes.statement:
Let $P \in \mathbb{Z}[z]$ be a polynomial with an integer root of multiplicity $1$. If $A \subseteq [N]^2$ does not contain a configuration of the form $(x, y),\; (x + P(z), y),\; (x, y + P(z))$ with $P(z) \neq 0$, then
$$|A| \ll_P \frac{N^2}{(\log\log\log N)^c}$$
for some absolute constant $c > 0$.
